title: Copilot Studio: Review panel shows agent readiness and policy blocks while building
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, Review behavior, licensing and governance controls are supported by the roadmap and Microsoft documentation. Add the Microsoft licensing source for the managed-environment qualification; no blocking correction is needed.

claims.quote: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents.

claims.claim: Each Review issue has a call to action such as Update settings or Contact admin that leads to resolution.

claims.claim: Tools, connectors, AI models and skills blocked by data policies or Advanced Connector Policies appear disabled wherever makers select them.
claims.quote: When a data policy or Advanced Connector Policy blocks a tool, connector, AI model, or skill, that item appears disabled wherever you'd normally select it, such as the tools list, model list, or skills list.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Hovering over the cross icon explains why an item is blocked before makers configure it.
claims.quote: Hover over the cross icon next to the disabled item to see why it's blocked.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The data policy blocking path is Power Platform admin center > Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > policy > Edit Policy > Next > Next > connector > three dots > Block.
claims.quote: select Security, and then select Data and privacy ... Select Data policy ... select the data policy and select Edit Policy ... Select Next ... Select Next ... Select the three dots ... select Block.

claims.claim: Set-DlpPolicy -PolicyName <policy name> -UpdatedPolicy <DLPPolicyDefinition object> updates a policy using its updated policy object.
claims.quote:
Updates a policy by using the UpdatedPolicy DLPPolicyDefinition object.
Set-DlpPolicy -PolicyName <String> -UpdatedPolicy <Object>

claims.where: controls[0].scope and note; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Data policies govern agents in the environments included in the policy's scope.
claims.quote: These data policies apply to Copilot Studio agents in the environments included in the policy's scope.

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for the tenant-wide data policy error contact email and Learn more link setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform data policy error contact email Learn more link admin center UI DlpErrorSettings. Opened admin-data-loss-prevention and PowerShell support excerpts; only PowerShell configuration found.

claims.claim: New-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings -TenantId "<tenant ID>" -ErrorSettings $ErrorSettingsObj configures the data policy error email and help link.
claims.quote: To add the email address and "Learn more" link, run the following PowerShell script. ... New-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings -TenantId "<tenant ID>" -ErrorSettings $ErrorSettingsObj

claims.claim: Set-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings updates an existing configuration.
claims.quote: To update an existing configuration, use the same PowerShell script, but replace New-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings with Set-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings.

claims.where: controls[1].scope and note; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The data policy error settings apply to all Power Platform apps in the specified tenant.
claims.quote: These settings apply to all Power Platform apps within the specified tenant.

claims.claim: An environment's Maker guidelines setting is reached through Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Maker guidelines > Environments > environment > Edit setting.
claims.quote: Environment: Select Copilot > Settings, and then select Maker guidelines. Select the Environments tab, select the environment, and then select Edit setting.

claims.claim: No API or automation for Maker guidelines is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Maker guidelines API; Maker guidelines Power Platform CLI; Maker guidelines Dataverse entity reference; Maker guidelines PowerShell API environment. Opened maker-guidelines and pac admin; no operation for this setting found.

claims.claim: Maker guidelines supports environment groups through the Environment groups tab and Edit rule.
claims.quote: Environment group in the Copilot area: Select Copilot > Settings, and then select Maker guidelines. Select the Environment groups tab, select the environment group, and then select Edit rule.

claims.where: summary; controls[2].governs; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Selecting Maker selects Review configures maker guidelines to appear in the Review pane.
claims.quote: Under Where to show the message, select Maker selects Review. ... When a maker selects Review for an agent in Copilot Studio, the pane shows the agent's blockers and warnings together with A message from your admin.

claims.claim: Maker guidelines messages are plain text with a 400-character limit.
claims.quote: Enter a plain-text message of up to 400 characters.

claims.claim: The standard-harness Agent status page documents custom guidance as preview.
claims.quote: Custom guidance message (preview)

claims.where: controls[3].governs and scope; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can configure custom guidance for blocked or disabled capabilities per environment or environment group.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can set an environment-level guidance message for users when they encounter a blocked or disabled capability. ... You can configure different messages for different environments and environment groups

claims.claim: Maker guidance is reached through Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Copilot Studio > Maker guidance > environment > Edit setting.
claims.quote: select Copilot, and then select Settings. ... under the Copilot Studio section, select Maker guidance. ... select the environments or environment groups ... Select Edit setting at the bottom of the panel

claims.claim: No API or automation for the Maker guidance setting is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Maker guidance PowerShell; Maker guidance Power Platform API; Maker guidance Dataverse table; Maker guidance pac env. Opened authoring-agent-status and pac admin; no operation for this setting found.

claims.claim: Custom guidance messages support plain text up to 400 characters.

claims.claim: Custom guidance messages are not localized.

claims.claim: An environment group's custom guidance message overrides the environment-level message.
claims.quote: The environment group message overrides the environment-level message.

claims.where: controls[4].ui and controls[4].api; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No UI setting or API to hide or turn off Review is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Review panel hide disable turn off admin setting. Opened both authoring-agent-status articles and harness overview; no Review visibility switch or corresponding API found.

claims.claim: The cited documentation does not explain how Maker guidelines and Maker guidance interact.
claims.quote: Searched: Maker guidelines Maker guidance. Opened maker-guidelines and authoring-agent-status; each describes its own setting, without specifying interaction or precedence between the two settings.

claims.claim: The standard-harness page says a previously allowed resource can later be blocked by a new policy.
claims.quote: If a resource (such as a knowledge source) was previously allowed but later blocked by a new policy, Agent status indicates which state (draft, published, or both) is affected.

claims.claim: Managed environments have a licensing condition.
claims.quote: When you activate managed environments in an environment, all active usage requires one of these standalone licenses or pay-as-you-go meters.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/managed-environment-licensing to sources as 'Licensing requirements for managed environments' to support the existing reference to that tier's licensing condition.
